rows.name: New York State Health Information Technology Advisory Committee
rows.mandate: Advises the Commissioner of Health on health information technology policy, EHR interoperability, and the statewide health information network. Coordinates with federal CMS and ONC initiatives.

rows.name: New York State Council on Mental Health
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor and Office of Mental Health on mental health policy, program standards, and services for New Yorkers with psychiatric disabilities. Monitors state hospital and community care systems.

rows.name: Commission on Quality of Care and Advocacy for Persons with Disabilities
rows.mandate: Protects and advocates for the rights of New Yorkers with disabilities. Investigates complaints, monitors state facilities, and advises on disability policy across executive agencies.

rows.name: New York Statewide Independent Living Council
rows.constituent: New Yorkers with disabilities seeking independent living
rows.mandate: Federally mandated council that develops the State Plan for Independent Living. Advocates for independent living services, accessible housing, and community integration for New Yorkers with disabilities.

rows.name: New York Housing Trust Fund Corporation — Board
rows.constituent: Low-income New Yorkers · housing assistance recipients
rows.mandate: Governs the Housing Trust Fund Corporation, which finances affordable housing development and preservation across New York State. Administers federal HOME and CDBG housing programs.

rows.name: NYS Environmental Justice Advisory Group
rows.mandate: Advises the Department of Environmental Conservation on environmental justice policy. Reviews permit applications, recommends mitigation for disproportionate environmental impacts in low-income communities.

rows.name: New York Opioid Settlement Fund Advisory Board
rows.constituent: New Yorkers affected by opioid epidemic
rows.mandate: Advises on distribution of New York's opioid litigation settlement funds. Recommends evidence-based investments in treatment, recovery, harm reduction, and prevention programs statewide.

rows.name: Governor's Advisory Committee for Black New Yorkers
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on policies and programs affecting Black New Yorkers. Monitors racial equity in state contracting, health, education, housing, and criminal justice outcomes.

rows.name: New York State Commission on the Status of Women
rows.mandate: Advises on policy affecting New York women and girls. Monitors gender equity in state programs, conducts research, and advocates for women's economic security, safety, and health.

rows.name: State Commission for the Blind — Advisory Board
rows.constituent: New Yorkers who are blind or visually impaired
rows.mandate: Advises the State Commission for the Blind on vocational rehabilitation, independent living, and employment programs for New Yorkers who are blind or visually impaired.
